test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As announced in June 2025, which of the following banks approved $109.97 million loan to boost advanced skills and employability in Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asian Development Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Asian Development Bank (ADB)** approved a **$109.97 million** loan in **June 2024/2025** to significantly enhance **advanced skills** and **employability** in the state of **Gujarat**, India.
 
• The primary objective of this funding is to support the **Gujarat Skill Development Project**, which aims to create a high-quality, industry-aligned workforce to meet the demands of modern economic sectors.
 
• A major component of this project is the establishment of the **Gujarat Skill University (GSU)**, which will serve as a premier institution for higher vocational education and advanced technical training.
 
• The project focuses on emerging and high-growth sectors such as **renewable energy**, **advanced manufacturing**, **electric vehicles**, and **digital technology**, aligning with **Industry 4.0** standards.
 
• The initiative seeks to improve the **Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET)** ecosystem by fostering **Public-Private Partnerships (PPP)** and ensuring that training programs are relevant to the needs of the **private sector**.
 
• The program also emphasizes **social inclusion**, providing specialized training and support to **women** and **marginalized communities** to improve their participation in the formal labor market.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Asian Development Bank (ADB)**:
 
 
• Established on **19 December 1966**, it is a regional development bank committed to achieving a prosperous, inclusive, and sustainable **Asia and the Pacific**.
 
• It is headquartered in **Mandaluyong, Metro Manila, Philippines**.
 
• As of **2024**, it has **69 members**, with **India** being one of its **founding members** and a top borrower.
 
 
 
• **World Bank**:
 
 
• Founded in **1944** at the **Bretton Woods Conference**, it is headquartered in **Washington, D.C., USA**.
 
• It provides **loans and grants** to the governments of low- and middle-income countries for the purpose of pursuing capital projects and poverty reduction.
 
 
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**:
 
 
• It is India's **central bank** and regulatory body responsible for the regulation of the **Indian banking system**.
 
• Established on **1 April 1935** under the **Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934**, it is headquartered in **Mumbai**.
 
 
 
• **State Bank of India (SBI)**:
 
 
• It is the largest **public sector bank** in India and a **Fortune Global 500** company.
 
• It has its headquarters in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**, and traces its origins to the **Bank of Calcutta** founded in **1806**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Gujarat’s Industrial Significance**: As a leading industrial state in India, Gujarat accounts for a significant portion of the country's **manufacturing output** and **exports**, necessitating a constant supply of highly skilled labor.
 
• **Employment Trends**: The transition toward **automation** and **digitalization** in Gujarat's industries has created a gap between traditional skills and industry requirements, which this **ADB-funded project** intends to bridge.
 
• **Strategic Partnership**: **India** is the **largest borrower** from the ADB's ordinary capital resources, with various projects spanning **transport**, **energy**, **urban development**, and **human capital** development across several states.
